findings.title: CLI exit code for recreate changed and 4 repurposed
findings.body: The PR changes RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3 and introduces FEATURE_DISABLED=4. Any automation written against the previous runtime behavior, where exit code 4 meant a recreate upgrade was required, may now misinterpret exit code 4 as feature-disabled and may miss the recreate result signaled by exit code 3. Since the guide documents these exit codes as a scripting contract, this change is a backward-incompatible CLI contract change and should be explicitly validated and called out.

findings.title: Exit-code contract for the new feature gate is not tested
findings.body: The PR adds exit code 4 for the disabled rolling-updates feature and changes the recreate exit code to 3, but the distribution tests only assert log messages. testFeatureNotEnabled asserts the error string but does not assert exit code 4, testWrongVersions does not assert exit code 3, and only the metadata subcommand is exercised for the disabled-feature path. Because the documentation presents these exit codes as a scriptable contract, regressions in the exit-code behavior would not be caught.

findings.title: Enabled features are overwritten instead of appended
findings.body: createInitialDeployment calls setEnabledFeatures(List.of(Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey())), which replaces any already-configured enabled features in the FeatureSpec. If the shared test fixture or future test setup enables other features, this helper will silently disable them. It should add rolling-updates to the existing enabled-feature list rather than overwrite the list.
